origins.section: OR-Tools Is One pip Package Holding Several Separate Solver Families
MathOpt, CP-SAT and the Linear Solver Wrapper Each Take a General Model
The Special-Purpose Solvers Take One Problem Shape, and No Model at All

recorded.outcome:q-knapsack-rule: The knapsack solver solved Job 1. Rules like "a child only with its parent" are another matter: "init has no argument for any of them."
